expected_behavior: Return available, held, and expiring wallet balance for authenticated customer
negative_or_edge_case: Guest or expired session must return unauthorized without leaking balance
test_signal: Backlog story and STCs for wallet visibility, auth, expiry, and accessibility

expected_behavior: Create idempotent wallet hold against checkout quote before payment capture
negative_or_edge_case: Duplicate hold request with same idempotency key must reuse existing hold
test_signal: STCs for duplicate request, partial redemption, and wallet-only checkout

expected_behavior: Persist store credit refund destination and wallet credit event
negative_or_edge_case: COD and fraud-held orders must not offer store credit refund
test_signal: RTM row should link refund destination to wallet/store credit stories and tests

expected_behavior: Return sellerGroups, shipmentGroups, sellerCouponBreakup, and group-level serviceability
negative_or_edge_case: One seller group unavailable after quote should allow remove-and-continue
test_signal: STCs for multi-seller cart, seller coupons, mixed serviceability, and keyboard flow

expected_behavior: Return shipment-level events with ETA, carrier, and customer visible message
negative_or_edge_case: Delayed shipment must not mark full order failed
test_signal: RTM must map split shipment requirement to shipment cards and order history tests

expected_behavior: Track challenge issued, verified, expired, failed, and released states
negative_or_edge_case: Three failed attempts should create fraud hold and block capture
test_signal: STCs for threshold boundary, expired challenge, hold release, and support audit

expected_behavior: Persist marketing analytics preference without blocking checkout
negative_or_edge_case: Essential order telemetry must continue when optional analytics is disabled
test_signal: STCs for opt-out, guest cookies, screen-reader toggle, and consent history

expected_behavior: Return masked chronological order event replay for support agents
negative_or_edge_case: Unavailable replay service must show retry-safe message and hide raw error payload
test_signal: Backlog and RTM must include support console event replay coverage
